verdict.rationale: A direct probe returned HTTP 200 for a machine-readable OpenAPI document at https://docs.helicone.ai/swagger.json, and the REST reference docs (e.g. POST /v1/request/query) appear to be generated from that spec. An AI-native user can download and consume it directly. Missing for 10: documentation describing the spec's coverage, completeness or versioning, and independent or hands-on corroboration of using the spec for client generation or agent tooling.
